section_summary.extract_value: This construct validity section reports that the BAS was positively associated with appearance evaluation (MBSRQ-AE) and general self-esteem (RSES) and negatively associated with Western beauty internalization, dieting, weight-related teasing, BMI, and several disordered eating symptom scales. The section references Table 3 for correlations. No study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') or sample descriptive statistics (e.g., country, N, age, percent white, mean BMI) are provided here.
